name: opencode-go-session
description: Fixes OpenCode Go's 400 'Request is missing x-opencode-session' for Kimi Code: a loopback proxy injects the required session header per request, derived from the calling session's prompt_cache_key. Concurrency-safe and stable across resume.

interface.shortDescription: Per-session x-opencode-session header for opencode-go models
interface.longDescription: OpenCode Go rejects requests that lack a stable x-opencode-session header. This plugin runs a loopback proxy (default 127.0.0.1:18321), points every opencode-go base_url in config.toml at it, and stamps each request with the caller's session id. Concurrent sessions get distinct ids; resumed sessions keep theirs.
